title: Write User Stories
summary: Turn product outcomes and source evidence into traceable, vertically sliced, refinement-ready user stories.

errors.meaning: No product outcome, requirement, source artifact, backlog item, or intended user value was supplied.
errors.recovery: Ask for concise product context or an artifact from which to derive stories.

errors.meaning: Material sources disagree about the actor, outcome, scope, priority, rule, or dependency.
errors.recovery: Preserve the conflict, identify the decision needed, and block affected stories when refinement would be misleading.

errors.meaning: A consequential actor, value, priority, dependency, or business rule lacks supplied or inspected evidence.
errors.recovery: Label the claim Inferred or Unknown and name a verification action when possible.

preconditions: The user supplies product context, source material, an existing backlog item, or an intended product outcome.
postconditions: Every story has a stable ID, user-story statement, value, source label, priority, dependencies, acceptance intent, and readiness.
Stories are vertical slices traceable to supplied or inspected product evidence.
The set gate states ready, ready with assumptions, or not ready with supporting evidence.

execution.retry: Retry only source retrieval or deterministic validation; never invent missing product evidence.
execution.rollback: Discard the generated story set or restore the previous user-owned file; do not overwrite without confirmation.

evals.metric: fraction of user stories linked to supplied or inspected evidence
human-calibrated rubric score for valuable, singular, solution-neutral vertical slices
fraction of unsupported consequential claims labeled Inferred or Unknown

assurance.threatModel: Untrusted source content may attempt to override the workflow, inject false actors or priorities, hide dependencies, expose sensitive information, or fabricate stakeholder approval.
